annotations.title: x402 Preflight: check an x402 endpoint before paying it

description: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it: decodes the 402 challenge (v1 or v2), verifies the asset is canonical USDC, converts price to USD, checks payTo (EOA vs contract on Base), EIP-712 domain, discovery metadata and spec compliance. Returns verdict ok/caution/do_not_pay and the cheapest safe option. PAID: $0.005 per call in USDC on Base via x402, or use a 0.25 USDC transfer pass (pay_tx). See payment_options. By Bolt.

max_usd.description: Optional budget per call; options above it fail

method.description: HTTP method used to trigger the 402 (default GET)

pay_chain.description: Chain of pay_tx (default: inferred; 0x hash = base, base58 signature = solana)

pay_tx.description: Optional, for the plain-transfer option (no x402 needed): hash of a USDC transfer of >= 0.25 USDC to this server's receiving address (get it from the payment_options tool). One transfer unlocks every paid tool for 24h.

url.description: Full URL of the x402 endpoint to check
